value.syntax: # [doc = " The three kinds of literal."] # [derive (Clone , Debug)] pub (crate) enum ValueKind { # [doc = " A numeric literal, kept as written."] Number (NumberToken) , # [doc = " A text literal: the characters between the quotes, escapes intact."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Escapes are not resolved here. `SESC` admits any printable"] # [doc = " character after the backslash, so what an escape *denotes* is a"] # [doc = " separate question from whether it is well formed, and the parser"] # [doc = " answers only the second."] Text (String) , # [doc = " A byte-string literal: the characters between the quotes, escapes"] # [doc = " intact, with the qualifier that says how to read them."] Bytes { # [doc = " `h`, `b64`, or nothing."] qual : ByteQual , # [doc = " The characters between the quotes, byte for byte."] raw : String , } , }
